## Description

Ranks stocks by gross profits relative to assets and builds long-only or long-short portfolios around high profitability.

## Where it may fit

Cross-sectional equity markets where accounting profitability contains information beyond price/book value.

## Vehicles

Equity factor, long-short, quant and multi-factor funds.

## Required data

Point-in-time income statements and balance sheets, prices, shares outstanding, industry classifications, delistings and costs.

## Caveats

Requires release-date-aware statements, consistent accounting definitions, industry controls and turnover/short-cost modeling.
